canonical_head_rule: canon/HEAD.json is a historical narrative checkpoint, never a dumping ground for engine policy; update only after real next author choice and canonical validation.
source_of_truth: story-archive/episodes/<ID>/draft/narrativa_integral.md plus immutable manifest + inbox + review + reader_receipt

before_new_episode.user_choice_for_previous: If author chose, save real choice, wait for canon workflow and read back HEAD before writing next new inbox.
before_new_episode.on_failure: BLOCK_NARRATIVE_COMPLETION_AND_REPORT_NO_SAVE; never use editorial summary as substituted prose
before_new_episode.r33_preparation: After actual closure, persist exact author-bound request in requests/<delivery_id>.json; workflow worldroot-r33-prepare publishes immutable preparations/<delivery_id>.json; re-fetch and verify before drafting. Never generate a choice for a request.
before_new_episode.r34_intent: New persisted R33-compatible requests must include r34_intent with seven distinct policy-backed dimensions, focal character fields, historical comparison and contextual opportunity mapping. No forced scenes or unsupported physical traits.
before_new_episode.r35_plan: Persist immutable R33-compatible request with r34_intent and r35_plan: real profile, scene budgets, lived beats, two references, separate adult opportunities; verify prep before prose.
before_new_episode.r35_refinement: Required r35_plan.refinement: five contextual axes with historical reference and scene mapping; source recovery for each focal character; docs/r35-literary-refinement.md.
before_new_episode.female_character_design: R35 automatically retrieves and binds focal dossiers from editorial/registries/female-character-design-d580-v2.json, with registry SHA. Separate AuthorDesign evidence from historical Response; verify age, conflicts, current location and agency. Fiches do not authorize attendance or events.

universal_codex.rule: Resolve focal identities, aliases, domain, origin, last evidenced location, possessions, powers, relationships, chronology and knowledge visibility against exact source before prose. Distinguish prospective design from historical evidence; do not assign a spell solely from a school link. Unknown remains explicit; approved age design is not retroactive biography.
universal_codex.runtime_status: R36_CODE_PINNED; SOURCE_BOUND_REVIEW_REQUIRED; no independent semantic certification

world_coherence.rule: Cross-check actor identity, age/design authority, relative capabilities, acquired spell, item identity and custody, time, travel, location and actual environmental dimensions. World and bodies remain independent and must interact causally. No arbitrary stat/rank, body reshaping, teleporting objects, unearned spell or victory. Unknowns require compatible neutral description, deliberate adaptation, evidenced development, or explicit hold. Keep GÊNESE outside ordinary combat grade.
world_coherence.measurements: Prospective design numbers and fictional test fixtures do not overwrite historical anatomy or buildings. Confirm load, opening, seat, access and posture if physically material. Do not derive internal vehicle clearances from external envelope.

for_each_episode.longform_segments: R35 mandatory 2–6 final immutable segments exact concatenation and SHA256; not a new narrative part or new choice. Earlier archives unchanged.
for_each_episode.write_endpoint: Authenticated ChatGPT GitHub connector create_file/update_file for story-archive/inbox/EPISODE.json (not automagical).
for_each_episode.verified_archival: Successful worldroot-draft-inbox action, archived narrative readback, SHA256 manifest, reader receipt, R14/R26 release gate and R27 handoff.
for_each_episode.next_author_choice: Only next actual USER_MESSAGE choice closes previous archived episode in canon and increments HEAD.
for_each_episode.r33_metadata: R33 archived episodes remain unchanged and independently verifiable; R34 retains R33 request/preparation and review bindings.
for_each_episode.r34_metadata: Historical R34 remains immutable; R35 retains r34_intent and review.
for_each_episode.r35_metadata: New episodes revision=35. Hard floor real prose: regular 8800, special 9500, finale 11000. Exception only explicit literal author choice line. R35 requires exact final segment receipts and visible reader text, scene/quality/opportunity review, versioned choices and header. No retroactive changes.
for_each_episode.r35_refinement: Required r35_review.refinement: concrete comparative review with two distinct narrative moments per axis; cadence signal contextual, not a line quota; avoid padding and forced conflict or romance. Prior archived episodes unaffected.
for_each_episode.female_character_design: For newly prepared episodes, keep the immutable focal design binding and verify its SHA before release; do not substitute illustrations or proposal ages for canonical facts.

universal_codex.rule: Review all appearing entities including silent actors, distinguish mentions from presence, register new identities and changes with exact episode/line/anchor/hash, track physical item custody and location independently of ownership, and separate learned/cast/mentioned magic. Draft candidates do not enter closed state until author choice and canonical validation. Preserve unresolved ambiguities. Keep evidence-based incremental deltas in proposed r33_review.codex_delta when engine deployment is validated; until then perform assisted review without altering immutable old receipts.
universal_codex.prototype_status: R36 candidate promoted by explicit exception; retain codex_delta and world_coherence validation; no automatic fact promotion; verify actual preparation and receipt

world_coherence.rule: Review each material cross-entity interaction, not only new facts: named magic must have individual prior or narrated acquisition; unnamed skills use demonstrated capability and conditions; distinguish inventory ownership, possession, storage, transfer, use and loss. Use channel-specific evidence for combat, context, technique, terrain and consequences; no predetermined win. Update literal records and preserve temporal cutoffs. Tests and quantitative grades are editorial backstage, not reader-facing game statistics.

for_each_episode.r36_metadata: R36 Evolution 7 is operational code revision; retain metadata.worldroot_revision=35, R35 longform/refinement and all prior contracts; when universal_codex bound, submit source-bound codex_delta, world_coherence and codex_sync as required by exact pinned engine. No automatic evaluation, no inferred author choice.

limits.note: GitHub Actions only react to repository updates; no chat message interception. Engine guards can enforce only when invoked. Never claim 100% automatic capture.

noncanonical_test_exclusion: LVI-C09-PI-D579-TESTE-R35 is a discarded experiment, never a narrative authority, choice, episode, character profile or continuity source. Retain editorial lessons only. Resume from actual D578 choice.
